quotes.text: This research presents the design and development of a decision support framework that applies life cycle thinking to guide the adaptation of digital twining for sustainable supply chain management.

This is made possible as a digital twin facilitates continuous data acquisition, visualization, and performs analytics including simulation modelling, machine learning, optimization and dynamic Life Cycle Assessment.
quotes.section: Abstract (only mention of machine learning in the whole chapter)

quotes.text: As shown in Fig. 1, the proposed framework mainly consists of four layers: physical layer, virtual layer, analytical layer and visualization layer.
Additionally, analytics related to environmental hotspot mitigation and resource optimization are carried out in this layer.
quotes.section: 3 Proposed Framework, Analytical layer (no method named)

quotes.text: If some data analytics related to optimizing kiln loading are added under resource optimization, considering prevailing condition of the kiln and the material to be loaded, the analytical layer can generate a few optimum kiln loading patterns.
quotes.section: 4 Application of Framework in the Industrial Context (only concrete analytics example; hypothetical, method unspecified)

quotes.text: When scenarios tested through this process produce acceptable LCIA results, they can be implemented in the physical layer via actuators or by decision makers depending on the type of decision.
